reviews.text: The darker pencil is great for drawing the under eye shadow. The colour of the rosy pencil is a bit dark for me. It is okay as a base but you need to put a lighter sparkle on top. Both are very creamy and don’t drag the skin.
reviews.zh: 深色嗰支畫臥蠶陰影一流。玫瑰色嗰支嘅色對我嚟講深咗少少。當底色用就OK，但要再喺上面加一層淺色亮片。兩支都好 creamy，唔會扯到皮膚。

reviews.text:
とにかくラメがすごくきれいで長持ちするし、この色はイエベブルベ問わず使いやすいニュートラルな色だと思う！最高
シングルアイシャドウはブルベ寄りだけど白味ピンクなので涙袋のベースとかによさそう！
reviews.zh: 總之亮片好靚又持久，呢隻色我覺得係中性色，無論暖調冷調都用得到！超讚。單色眼影偏冷調，但係偏白嘅粉紅色，做臥蠶底色應該幾好！

reviews.text: The colour looks very natural; it makes your eyes look bigger and matches well with your makeup.
reviews.zh: 顏色好自然，望落眼睛大啲，同妝容好夾。

reviews.text: 期待していたほど涙袋がぷっくりというわけではなく、ナチュラルな涙袋だった。ラメがちらっと光る感じで可愛かった。
reviews.zh: 唔係預期嗰種飽滿嘅臥蠶，而係自然嘅臥蠶。亮片微微閃嘅感覺好得意。

reviews.text: Super cute and I love how it’s dual. The color taro bunny and it’s a cute pink shade.
reviews.zh: 超得意，我鍾意佢係雙頭嘅。色號係 taro bunny，係一隻得意嘅粉紅色調。

reviews.text: The 2aN aegyosal pencils are my favorites. Easy to use and the shimmer isn’t too glittery. Perfect for everyday use.
reviews.zh: 2aN 嘅臥蠶筆係我最鍾意嘅。好用，亮片都唔會太閃。日日用都啱。

reviews.text: Practical, efficient and looks stunning every time!! Love the fact that I don’t need to pick up a brush, dip it in the eyeshadow, adjust the amount and then put it on. It’s just open cap, twist, on you go. And the glitters weren’t less chunky because of the stick form so the glittery-ness was just as nice as any single eyeshadow you might pick up after testing it on the back of your hand and fasincated by how the light bounces around because of it kind of eyeshadow. And the aegyosal shading is a really nice, natural colour that gets the job done efficiently too. The gifted single shadow I use to mix in the the other blush colours and I’m really enjoying how versatile it is too. 12 out of 10 efficiency and practicality. Might not be the most water proof though. But this don’t make any messes like mascaras for example so I don’t mind that part as much.
reviews.zh: 實用、高效，每次用都好好睇！！最鍾意唔使搵掃、唔使沾眼影、唔使調份量再搽上面。開蓋、轉出嚟、用就得。而且亮片冇因為棒狀而變細粒，所以閃度同你喺手背試完覺得「嘩啲光彈嚟彈去好靚」嗰啲單色眼影一樣靚。臥蠶陰影個色好靚好自然，高效完成任務。送嗰個單色眼影我用嚟溝其他胭脂色，幾百搭，我好enjoy。效率同實用性 10分滿分俾12分。可能唔算最防水。但呢樣嘢唔會好似睫毛液咁整到成塊面都係污糟，所以呢部分我冇咁介意。

reviews.text: 2aN is my favorite aegyosal liner. The liner pencil looks very natural and easy to blend out, but when it dries it stays in place very well. The shimmer is very natural and does look too overpowering which is what I prefer. It makes making the aegyosal so easy.
reviews.zh: 2aN 係我最鍾意嘅臥蠶筆。畫出嚟好自然又好容易推開，但乾咗之後好貼服。亮片好自然，唔會太搶眼，呢樣正正我鍾意。畫臥蠶從此變得好簡單。
